diagnosis: The customer rotated their IdP signing certificate, leading to assertion errors for users. This matches the symptoms described in kb-0006 regarding metadata mismatch.
reply: I am sorry to hear that your users are experiencing assertion errors during SSO sign-in. Based on the details provided, this often occurs when an identity provider certificate is rotated without updating the metadata. Please refer to our guide 'SSO metadata mismatch after an identity provider change' (kb-0006), which recommends re-uploading the metadata and testing with a single account before re-enabling enforcement.
